page_title: LEV 1-0 MAI | Bayer Leverkusen v Mainz 14/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Tobias Welz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Holy smokes, you don't see that very often! Bo Henriksen gets a second yellow card and has to leave the bench.
90+1' Bo Henriksen isn't happy on the touchline after referee Tobias Welz shows him a yellow card.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
88' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Florian Wirtz.
88' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
87' Today's referee Tobias Welz rightly decides to book Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) for his harsh tackle.
84' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Robin Zentner pulls off a great save to deny Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
82' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

81' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the right side of the goal, but Robin Zentner made a crucial save!
80' Substitution. Phillipp Mwene walks off the pitch and Silvan Widmer (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.
80' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) replaces Stefan Bell.
79' Stefan Bell (Mainz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
79' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Mainz in a dangerous position.
78' Stefan Bell (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick, but Robin Zentner reads it well and stops the effort.
74' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.

74' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Robin Zentner makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
71' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
69' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
68' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Anthony Caci (Mainz), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jae-Sung Lee walks off the pitch to be replaced by Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz).
66' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nelson Weiper (Mainz) replacing Armindo Sieb.
65' Tobias Welz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Paul Nebel (Mainz) and blew his whistle. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Patrik Schick departs the field of play to be replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
62' There's an opportunity for Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
62' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
61' The corner from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Robin Zentner.

61' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
60' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
59' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
58' Tobias Welz blows his whistle as Stefan Bell (Mainz) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
58' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) took the corner.

57' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Matej Kovar is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee points to the corner flag and Mainz will take a corner.
54' It looks like Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Welz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick.
51' Tobias Welz shows the yellow card to Stefan Bell (Mainz) for a heavy challenge.
50' Paul Nebel (Mainz) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

48' 1 - 0 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
48' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
47' Stefan Bell (Mainz) makes a strong challenge and Tobias Welz blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Tobias Welz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away.
45+2' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
42' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

41' The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Robin Zentner has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
40' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) was too forceful with his tackle and Tobias Welz interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick near the side line.
37' An accurate cross finds its way to Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) who sends in a bullet header towards the top of the net from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
36' The linesman signals that Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
33' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
32' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
30' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
29' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Welz saw the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Mainz.
28' Paul Nebel (Mainz) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
28' Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
26' Dangerous play by Phillipp Mwene (Mainz). Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a free kick.
25' The linesman raises his flag. Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is adjudged offside.
23' Good team movement sets up Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
23' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' Bayer Leverkusen fail to score from a corner as Robin Zentner (Mainz) leaps to collect the ball.
19' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
18' He should have scored! Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
17' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Welz ignores the protests.
15' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
11' Tobias Welz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Danny da Costa (Mainz). It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
10' Danny da Costa (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
7' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
3' Bo Henriksen is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jonathan Burkardt suffers an injury and Armindo Sieb (Mainz) comes on.
2' The game is interrupted now, Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Mainz will take the kick-off.
Tobias Welz will officiate today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
